evaluation_criteria.note: Candidate arm must not degrade pooled out-of-fold AUC (delta >= 0, CI lower >= -0.01) and must not degrade calibration beyond the declared margins (Brier <= +0.005 absolute, ECE <= +0.02 absolute) versus the matched reference arm; calibration deltas are reported per year.

hypothesis_text: Are probability estimates stable across years, tickers, and market regimes?
